name: Organizations
description: Organizations capabilities. Includes Create or update a membership for the organization associated with the API key (requires organization-scoped API key), Delete a membership from the organization associated with the API key (requires organization-scoped API key), Get all API keys for the organization associated with the API key (requires organization-scoped API key), Get all memberships for the organization associated with the API key (requires organization-scoped API key), Get all projects for the organization associated with the API key (requires organization-scoped API key).
